statements.impact_statement: The advisory affects only aws-sdk-go v1's S3 encryption client (service/s3/s3crypto). grafana/loki contains zero references to s3crypto, and Go links only imported packages into the binary, so the vulnerable code is not present. No fixed aws-sdk-go v1 release exists or is planned (fixed only in aws-sdk-go-v2).
